why: The common case: unit prices per line, freight, lead time in weeks, no subtotal or grand total stated.
text:
Hi Jane,

Thanks for the RFQ. Pricing for the water package, FOB our yard:

- 8" PVC C900 DR18 pipe, 1,450 LF @ $28.50/LF
- 8" Gate valve w/ box, 9 EA @ $1,240.00 each
- Fire hydrant assembly, 5 EA @ $3,150.00 each

Freight to Taylor, TX: $1,850.00
Lead time: 3 weeks ARO. Quote valid 30 days.

Best,
Mike
Core & Main — Austin
regex_note: The regex fallback reads unit-priced lines as line items (with the quantity when the supplier states it) and leaves total/material null for finalize_quote() to compute — it used to take the LARGEST dollar figure ($3,150, a unit price) as the total.

expect_finalized.notes_contains: Computed from line items: material subtotal, total.
